name: Regretevator [ ELEVATOR SIMULATOR ]
desc:
Room infinity, now going up! Regretevator is a random style elevator puzzle game where you can hang out, look for secrets, and have fun. 

hit 'G' for the emote and stickers menu

🎮 New Update WEEKLY!

⭐ Coins multiplier on weekends! (Friday - Sunday) [Coin purchases are also affected by the Coin multiplier!] 

👽 Follow for updates and leave a like to help support the development of the game for free! 

🎵 Song for the Maze floor is "Kubbi // Spiritdancer" 

🐸 Join the group for updates!
